evidence.original_label: 验收超15台离子注入机实现新高
evidence.excerpt: 公司旗下凯世通主要聚焦离子注入机等关键装备领域，持续加强核心技术研发与晶圆厂客户服务能力。2025 年，公司新签 4 家客户订单，已实现交付 10 多台 12 英寸离子注入机，验收超 15 台离子注入机实现新高。
evidence.review_notes: Re-sweep of a page in a registered original that earlier extraction never opened. Extracted by one agent and independently verified by a separate agent that reopened the original page rather than the extractor summary.

notes: FY2025 ion-implanter acceptances by Kingstone (凯世通), the Xiandao Jidian / Wanye group's implant subsidiary; the paragraph subject is stated explicitly as 公司旗下凯世通. 超 15 台 is a lower bound and is NOT converted to a point value. Acceptance (验收) is distinct from delivery (交付) and from revenue recognition. Scope is the generic Kingstone operating-milestone perimeter because this clause says 验收超 15 台离子注入机 with no 12-inch qualifier, unlike the delivery clause in the same sentence (10 多台 12 英寸离子注入机); per kingstone_generic_implant_operating_milestones the 12-inch qualifier must not be inherited across clauses. Verbatim restatement in the same filing at physical p.3 (chairman's letter): 验收数量超 15 台实现新高 — one row only, and independent_corroboration stays false because both mentions are the same issuer document. Consistency check: the FY2024 annual report discloses 3 acceptances in Q1 2025 (see RESWEEP-E-KINGSTONE-2025Q1-P20-ACCEPTANCES), which is compatible with a full-year figure above 15. Duplicate row XIADAO2025-KS-ACCEPTANCES from a parallel extraction packet was dropped at integration; the 12-inch qualifier is deliberately not inherited from the adjacent clause.

evidence.original_label: 凯世通获得5家客户订单
evidence.excerpt: 报告期内，公司旗下凯世通及嘉芯半导体共获得集成电路设备订单近 2.4 亿元。其中凯世通获得 5 家客户订单，包括 3 家国内 12 英寸晶圆厂头部客户的批量重复订单，并新增 2 家新客户订单。
evidence.review_notes: Re-sweep of a page in a registered original that earlier extraction never opened. Extracted by one agent and independently verified by a separate agent that reopened the original page rather than the extractor summary.

notes: Number of customers that placed orders with Kingstone during FY2024. ENTITY CARE: the preceding sentence in the same paragraph is a COMBINED figure for two sibling equipment subsidiaries (凯世通及嘉芯半导体共获得…近 2.4 亿元) and is held, not extracted; this row uses only the 其中凯世通 carve-out, which names Kingstone explicitly. Not attributed to the listed parent (xiandao_jidian / Wanye Enterprises), whose FY2024 reporting also contains a property business and Jiaxin Semiconductor's etch / deposition / RTP lines. Period flow of ordering customers, not a cumulative base. Composition 3 repeat 12-inch head customers + 2 new customers = 5, consistent with the identical 3 + 2 wording at p.3 (chairman's letter) and p.13 (MD&A); the split itself is held pending dedicated scopes. No exact as-of date stated, hence reported_customer_count_period_status.

evidence.original_label: 累计服务国内超14条重点集成电路产线
evidence.excerpt: 2020 年至今，凯世通已完成订单交付超过 55 台，主要服务于先进逻辑、先进存储、功率器件、CIS 图像传感器、光电芯片等应用领域。凯世通已构建覆盖大束流、中束流、高能、氢离子、化合物半导体等全系列产品矩阵，并覆盖超低温、高温等先进工艺需求，自筑国产离子注入零部件平台，累计服务国内超 14 条重点集成电路产线，晶圆产品片过货量超 2000 万片。
evidence.review_notes: Re-sweep of a page in a registered original that earlier extraction never opened. Extracted by one agent and independently verified by a separate agent that reopened the original page rather than the extractor summary.

notes: Domestic Chinese IC production lines served cumulatively by Kingstone ion implanters since 2020. 条生产线 -> production_line: this counts LINES, not customers and not tools; it must not be read against the separately registered cumulative customer count of 16 (H126-KS-CUST) or the cumulative delivery count of >55 systems (H126-KS-CUMSHIP). 超 14 条 is a lower bound, not converted. 国内 -> geography source_defined_domestic. Period: the source window is 2020 年至今 with no 2026-06-30 bridge, so the start is taken as 2020-01-01 from 2020 年 and the end uses the 2026-08-01 disclosure-date proxy already applied to the sibling cumulative-delivery row H126-KS-CUMSHIP. The customer_production_lines metric carries time_base period_status, which requires an interval rather than an as-of point, so kind is multi_year even though the claim is cumulative in substance.

evidence.original_label: 晶圆产品片过货量超2000万片
evidence.excerpt: 2020 年至今，凯世通已完成订单交付超过 55 台…累计服务国内超 14 条重点集成电路产线，晶圆产品片过货量超 2000 万片，多系列产品在关键节点上的工艺覆盖率和良率满足生产要求，产能置换率不断提升。
evidence.review_notes: Re-sweep of a page in a registered original that earlier extraction never opened. Extracted by one agent and independently verified by a separate agent that reopened the original page rather than the extractor summary.

notes: Cumulative wafer-processing quantity (过货量) run through Kingstone's DELIVERED implanter fleet on customer production lines since 2020, disclosed in the same sentence as the >55 cumulative deliveries and the >14 domestic production lines. Metric choice: reported_customer_fleet_wafer_processing_quantity, because the figure is fleet-level; cumulative_wafer_passes is explicitly defined in this repo as passes processed by a stated SINGLE tool and would misrepresent the claim. 片 here does not prove distinct wafer identities and must not be equated with tool count or shipments. 超 2000 万片 is a lower bound; see evidence.conversion for the 万片 -> 亿片 unit bridge. Geography left at all_reported_geographies: the adjacent clause is 国内-qualified but this clause carries no geography qualifier of its own. Period: 2020 年至今 with no explicit 2026-06-30 bridge, so the 2026-08-01 disclosure-date proxy is used, matching H126-KS-CUMSHIP. Compare the FY2025 annual report's narrower 12-inch / low-energy-high-current-only figure of >1000 万片 (held, needs a product-line scope): that is a subset, not a prior value of this series. Source 超 2000 万片 = 2000 wafer_pass_10k = 0.2 of the metric's only registered unit 100_million_wafer (亿片). Exact decimal conversion, no rounding, bound preserved as gt. Native 万片 recorded in the wafer_processing_quantity dimension; wafer_pass is a different base unit reserved for single-tool pass counts.
